method: Compared all 81 runtime text/metadata records with the reviewed text snapshot and read each script, shared helper or reprint implementation. Checked timing, costs, forms, ownership, targets, partial resolution, then/may/each wording, quantities, limits, lifetimes and keywords. Cross-checked nine changed originals against cached card scans; the second Bond printing shares its script.

fixes.61002: Require evidence placement before the then-clause can defeat a villain.
fixes.61006: Allow evidence and encounter effects when no threat can be removed.
fixes.61012: Filter enemies that cannot legally be attacked before resolving area damage.
fixes.61026: Reject play when neither exhaust/ready choice is legal.
fixes.61027: Allow healing without threat; allocate total healing before resolving each character once.
fixes.62005: Allow tough gain when no threat can be removed.
fixes.62006: Respect Guard and cannot-be-attacked effects; reject no-target play except when stunned.
fixes.62009: Remove the unprinted from-hand limitation from the play response.
fixes.62012: Trigger prevention when defending and retain its ATK value through attack resolution.

shared_engine_fix: MainScheme.CanBeThwartBy rejects crisis-blocked schemes while preserving explicit ignore-crisis effects.
limits: A clause-level review plus deterministic headless gameplay coverage, not an exhaustive proof across every scenario and deck combination. Cruisin's existing as-if-in-hand play path already worked; its response filter was aligned with the broader printed trigger.
